hardship.program: Chase Credit Card Payment Assistance / Hardship & Forbearance Agreement
hardship.offers: Temporary waiving or lowering of interest and late fees, reduced minimum payments, or a temporary forbearance/hardship repayment schedule
hardship.qualifies: Cardholders experiencing a recent financial setback such as job loss, extended medical leave, illness, or natural disaster
hardship.how_to_ask: Call the number on the back of your Chase card or sign in to Chase online/mobile banking to request the payment assistance / hardship team
hardship.account_effect: Account charging privileges may be suspended or closed depending on the workout or settlement agreement; deferment/forbearance marks may appear on credit reports
hardship.quote: Negotiation usually involves a single large lump sum payment, the temporary waiving or lowering of interest and late fees and/or a forbearance or hardship agreement to temporarily offer relief while you deal with a recent financial setback, such as job loss.

hardship.program: American Express Financial Relief Program FAQ
hardship.offers: Lowered monthly minimum payment, reduced APR (such as 0% to 9.99% depending on plan tier), and waived late payment fees for a short-term (12-month) or long-term (36–60 month) plan
hardship.qualifies: Eligible Card Members experiencing temporary or ongoing financial hardship who enroll and make the required initial payment by the deadline
hardship.how_to_ask: Log in to your American Express online account or mobile app, use Amex live chat, or call 1-866-703-4169 to speak with a Customer Care Professional about the Financial Relief Program
hardship.account_effect: Enrolled cards cannot be used to make new purchases and your credit limit may be reduced while in the program, or accounts may be permanently cancelled on long-term plans
hardship.quote: Temporarily lower your interest rate / Provide relief from late payment fees / Lower your monthly payment ... please call us at 1-866-703-4169

hardship.program: Citi Credit Card Hardship Program / Payment Assistance
hardship.offers: Case-by-case payment relief including pausing payments, lowering your interest rate, waiving late fees, or reducing your minimum payment
hardship.qualifies: Cardholders facing documented financial hardship such as job loss (layoff notice) or unexpected medical bills
hardship.how_to_ask: Call the customer service number on the back of your Citi credit card or use the Citi Mobile App / online account portal to speak with a specialist about hardship options
hardship.account_effect: Account charging privileges are typically frozen or closed while enrolled in a hardship repayment plan
hardship.quote: If you're facing financial hardship, some lenders may lower or wipe out your debt on a case-by-case basis through a credit card hardship program. However, you usually need to show proof, like medical bills or a layoff notice from your employer. But, generally, a hardship program may allow you to negotiate some of the following: Pausing payment. Lowering your interest rate. Waiving your late fees. Reducing your minimum payment.

hardship.program: Capital One Credit Card Forbearance / Temporary Hardship Program
hardship.offers: Lower monthly minimum payments, a lower interest rate, a structured repayment plan, or the ability to miss one or multiple payments without a penalty charge
hardship.qualifies: Cardholders struggling to make minimum monthly payments due to short-term financial hardship such as job loss or illness
hardship.how_to_ask: Call the number on the back of your Capital One card or sign in to your Capital One online account to request credit card forbearance or hardship assistance
hardship.account_effect: Account is reported as current or in forbearance rather than delinquent if terms are met, though charging privileges may be restricted and a forbearance notation may appear on credit reports
hardship.quote: Credit card forbearance is a temporary hardship program that some card issuers offer. Forbearance may provide you with: Lower monthly payments, A lower interest rate, A repayment plan, The ability to miss one or multiple payments without a penalty charge.

hardship.program: Bank of America Client Assistance / Credit Card Hardship & Forbearance Program
hardship.offers: Waived late fees, lowered minimum monthly payment or reduced interest rate, or a temporary payment pause/forbearance for a predetermined period
hardship.qualifies: Clients experiencing temporary financial hardship, loss of income, medical emergencies, or natural disasters
hardship.how_to_ask: Call the customer service number on the back of your Bank of America credit card or contact Client Assistance through Online Banking to discuss hardship workout options
hardship.account_effect: Interest usually continues to accrue during any payment pause, and credit card accounts placed on a workout or debt management plan may be closed to new purchases
hardship.quote: Some credit card companies may waive fees or lower your minimum payment or interest rate. Creditors are likely to be more amenable to negotiations if you contact them directly.

hardship.program: Discover payment programs (credit-card delinquency page)
hardship.offers: Temporary APR reduction, lowered minimum monthly payments, or suppression of late fees tailored to short-term financial emergencies
hardship.qualifies: Cardmembers facing financial emergencies such as job loss, medical bills, or income reduction
hardship.how_to_ask: Call 1-800-DISCOVER (1-800-347-2683) or message customer service in the Discover mobile app or website and ask about payment assistance programs
hardship.account_effect: Card charging privileges may be temporarily suspended or closed depending on the length and structure of the repayment plan
hardship.quote: We may be able to make your payments more affordable. See if you're eligible for a payment program.

hardship.program: Wells Fargo Credit Card Payment Assistance / Short-Term & Long-Term Workout Plans
hardship.offers: Short-term or long-term payment relief plans featuring reduced interest rates, waived late fees, and lower fixed monthly payments
hardship.qualifies: Wells Fargo cardholders experiencing unemployment, medical expenses, divorce, disaster, or other financial hardship
hardship.how_to_ask: Call Wells Fargo Credit Card Payment Assistance at 1-800-400-9423 (or 1-800-642-4720 on the back of the card) to review eligibility with a specialist
hardship.account_effect: Card use is restricted or the credit card account is closed upon enrollment in a fixed-term hardship workout plan
hardship.quote: If you need help with making a payment, call us at 1-800-400-9423. We have several options that may help you.

hardship.program: U.S. Bank past-due credit card help (KB0205760)
hardship.offers: Structured payment plans, temporary minimum payment reductions, or interest rate and fee adjustments based on financial review
hardship.qualifies: Customers facing unexpected life events, income reduction, or financial difficulty
hardship.how_to_ask: Call the U.S. Bank payment assistance team at 855-282-6161 (Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. CT) or submit a financial assistance request online
hardship.account_effect: Revolving credit line may be suspended or closed while repaying under a modified hardship schedule
hardship.quote: If you are having trouble paying your past due credit card balance, help may be available. You can review payment plan options in digital banking to see what works best for you.

hardship.program: Synchrony Bank Hardship Workout / Optional Payment Security Program
hardship.offers: Case-by-case workout plans (reduced APR and fixed monthly payment over 60 months) or, for enrolled Payment Security customers, cancellation of minimum payments for 1 to 6 months
hardship.qualifies: Cardholders facing involuntary job loss, disability, hospitalization, or documented financial hardship
hardship.how_to_ask: Call the customer service number on the back of your Synchrony partner card (or 1-800-815-4051 for Payment Security claims) to request hardship assistance
hardship.account_effect: Workout plans typically freeze or close the retail credit card account; Payment Security suspends minimum payment obligations during the covered event
hardship.quote: Cancellation of your Synchrony credit card minimum payment for one to six months, depending on the covered event and the time period involved.

hardship.program: Barclays Card Servicing Hardship & Payment Assistance Plan
hardship.offers: Temporary or long-term reduced APR and lowered minimum monthly payment, plus waiver of late fees during the arrangement
hardship.qualifies: Cardmembers experiencing financial difficulty who contact Barclays Card Servicing
hardship.how_to_ask: Call Barclays Customer Service at 1-888-232-0780 or 1-877-523-0478 and ask to speak with a specialist about payment assistance
hardship.account_effect: Card charging privileges are suspended or the account is closed while on the reduced-rate repayment plan
hardship.quote: General Inquiries. 877-523-0478.

hardship.program: Apple Card Payment Assistance / Customer Assistance Program
hardship.offers: Short-term payment deferrals or reduced-interest workout payment plans tailored to the cardholder's financial situation
hardship.qualifies: Apple Card owners or co-owners experiencing financial hardship or natural disasters
hardship.how_to_ask: Open the Wallet app on iPhone, tap Apple Card, tap the More button, tap Message to chat with an Apple Card Specialist at Goldman Sachs, or call 1-877-255-5923
hardship.account_effect: Ability to make new purchases on Apple Card may be restricted while enrolled in a payment assistance plan
hardship.quote: About Apple Card payment assistance. If you're having trouble making monthly payments, experiencing financial hardship,

hardship.program: Navy Federal Repayment Assistance & Debt Restructuring Program
hardship.offers: Potential fee forgiveness, lower monthly payments, lower interest rates, or term extensions / workout plans
hardship.qualifies: Members communicating with Navy Federal about unexpected financial challenges or hardship
hardship.how_to_ask: Call Navy Federal 24/7 Member Services at 1-888-842-6328 or send a secure message online to request repayment assistance
hardship.account_effect: Credit line may be frozen or restructured into a fixed repayment schedule until the balance is repaid
hardship.quote: Many lenders are willing to work with you. There may be repayment assistance programs available to potentially lower your monthly payments or your interest rate. You may even be able to get more time to repay your debt.

hardship.program: USAA Member Financial Hardship & Payment Relief Program
hardship.offers: Deferred payment options on credit cards, payment extensions, and 0% interest disruption loans ($500 to $6,000) during government shutdowns or disasters
hardship.qualifies: USAA members experiencing financial difficulty, disrupted pay, or disaster impacts
hardship.how_to_ask: Call USAA Bank customer service (1-800-531-8722 or 1-855-430-8489 for payment assistance) or apply online under Support > Financial Hardship
hardship.account_effect: Deferred payments postpone due dates while regular interest may continue to accrue on credit card balances
hardship.quote: If you're without a paycheck and can't pay your bills, it's important to let those companies know of your financial difficulty. Contact your credit card companies to see if they have any deferred payment options.

hardship.program: PNC Retail Lending Solutions Hardship Assistance Program
hardship.offers: Short-term payment suspension/forbearance (up to 3 months with no late fees) or long-term modification/repayment plan with reduced monthly payments
hardship.qualifies: PNC credit card, personal line of credit, or loan customers experiencing short-term or long-term hardship (excluding active bankruptcy)
hardship.how_to_ask: Call PNC Consumer Credit Card Hardship Consultants at 1-800-544-3623 (or 1-866-622-2657 for Personal Loans/Lines) or complete the online PNC Hardship Application
hardship.account_effect: Interest continues to accrue during suspension, late fees are waived, and credit is reported based on the status of the loan when suspension was requested
hardship.quote: PNC Retail Lending Solutions Consultants are available to offer product specific hardship assistance. Auto/Marine/Boat/RV: 1-800-642-6323. Consumer Credit Card: 1-800-544-3623.

hardship.program: Truist Personal Loan & Credit Payment Relief Program
hardship.offers: Temporary suspension of payments (forbearance) with no late fees or penalties, or structured repayment plans
hardship.qualifies: Borrowers with an account open at least 9 months and a strong payment history facing temporary income reduction, unexpected one-time expenses, or natural disasters
hardship.how_to_ask: Call the number on the back of your Truist card or 844-4TRUIST (844-487-8478) and review the Truist Payment Relief Options portal
hardship.account_effect: Account is not reported as delinquent to credit agencies during approved forbearance, though interest continues to accrue
hardship.quote: You might qualify for a temporary suspension of personal loan payments if you're having short-term financial difficulties caused by: Temporary reduction in your income. Unexpected, one-time expenses. Natural disasters, like a flood or fire.

hardship.program: KeyBank Credit Card and Lines of Credit Payment Assistance (Re-Age & Long-Term Hardship Plan)
hardship.offers: Re-age program (returning a delinquent account to current status after approved payments) or a long-term hardship plan with reduced monthly minimum payments
hardship.qualifies: KeyBank credit card or personal line of credit clients unable to afford current monthly minimum payments or past due due to hardship
hardship.how_to_ask: Call KeyBank Borrower Assistance at 1-866-425-3449 (Monday–Thursday 8 a.m.–7 p.m. ET, Friday 8 a.m.–5 p.m. ET) with your monthly income, household expenses, and hardship explanation
hardship.account_effect: Re-aging returns a delinquent account to current status after qualifying payments; long-term hardship plans restrict credit line usage while paying down the balance
hardship.quote: If you're experiencing difficulty paying your KeyBank credit card or personal line of credit, we may be able to offer you assistance. Depending on your situation, you may be eligible for a re-age or long-term hardship plan.

hardship.program: Regions Customer Assistance Program
hardship.offers: Customized payment options, fee waivers, or payment deferrals for credit cards and personal loans
hardship.qualifies: Customers struggling to make monthly payments due to financial hardship or natural disaster
hardship.how_to_ask: Call the Regions Customer Assistance Program line at 1-800-221-7471 or 1-866-298-1113 (or 1-800-253-2265 for personal credit cards)
hardship.account_effect: Account charging privileges may be suspended during a structured repayment or workout arrangement
hardship.quote: Our customer assistance program is designed to assist customers struggling to make payments due to financial hardship or natural disaster. You can call 1-800-221-7471 to discuss payment options.

hardship.program: Fifth Third Loan & Credit Card Hardship Assistance Program
hardship.offers: Lowered interest rate, extended repayment term, or deferred monthly payments depending on loan or card type
hardship.qualifies: Customers experiencing financial hardship regarding a credit card, auto loan, home equity line, or personal loan
hardship.how_to_ask: Call Fifth Third Hardship Assistance at 1-800-375-1745 (option 3) or 1-866-601-6391 (Monday–Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET), or send a secure message in online/mobile banking
hardship.account_effect: Credit card or credit line privileges may be frozen while paying under a modified rate or deferred payment arrangement
hardship.quote: When we receive your application, we will review it for eligibility and determine which solutions best fit your circumstances. Some of the solutions available may include: The interest rate may be lowered. The term of the loan may be extended. Your monthly payments may be deferred.

hardship.lender: BMO (formerly Bank of the West / BMO Harris)
hardship.program: BMO Financial Relief & Payment Assistance Program
hardship.offers: Waived account fees (including late fees), extended payment due dates, and reduced monthly payments for eligible loans, lines of credit, and credit cards
hardship.qualifies: Eligible BMO credit card and personal loan customers impacted by financial hardship or natural disaster
hardship.how_to_ask: Call BMO Customer Contact Center 24/7 at 1-888-340-2265 or visit a BMO financial center to request payment relief
hardship.account_effect: Delinquency fees are waived during the relief period; long-term reduced payment plans may restrict new credit card charges
hardship.quote: For eligible customers, loan, line of credit, or credit card relief includes 2 : Account fees, including late fees, will be waived. Payment due dates for mortgages, loans, and lines of credit will be extended. Reduced payments may be available.

hardship.program: Credit One Bank Hardship / Modified Payment Plan & Optional Credit Protection
hardship.offers: Modified payment plans, lowered interest rate, or one-time goodwill late-payment adjustments; optional Credit Protection suspends minimum payments during covered unemployment or disability
hardship.qualifies: Cardmembers experiencing financial crisis, involuntary unemployment, or verified disability
hardship.how_to_ask: Call Credit One Bank Customer Service at 1-877-825-3242 (number on the back of the card) before missing a payment and ask for a hardship program or modified payment plan
hardship.account_effect: Account is typically frozen or closed during a hardship workout plan; Credit Protection freezes card use while benefits are active
hardship.quote: Payment plans or forbearance: Your lender may offer hardship programs or modified payment plans if you let them know you're going through tough times.

hardship.lender: Bread Financial (Comenity Bank / Comenity Capital Bank)
hardship.program: Bread Financial / Comenity Hardship Program & Courtesy Fee Waiver
hardship.offers: One-time courtesy late-fee waiver or enrollment in a structured hardship repayment program with reduced APR/minimum payment
hardship.qualifies: Cardholders in good standing facing a serious life situation such as loss of a job or medical emergency
hardship.how_to_ask: Call the Comenity / Bread Financial customer service number on the back of your card or message through Account Center before missing a payment to ask if a hardship program is available
hardship.account_effect: Enrolling in a hardship program may restrict or close the card account and can affect creditworthiness depending on program terms
hardship.quote: The issuer may have some sort of late-fee waiver they can offer you as a one-time courtesy. Or if you have a more serious life situation, like loss of a job, you can ask if a hardship program is available and enroll in that.

hardship.program: Payment Assistance Programs
hardship.offers: Hardship program (may reduce interest rate and monthly payment); re-age program; settlement; late-fee waivers
hardship.how_to_ask: Call 866-922-3925, Mon-Fri 8am-5pm ET
hardship.quote: Hardship program - Special programs that may reduce your interest rate and monthly payment. Re-age program - Bring your account current without paying the full past-due amount. Settlement ... Fee waivers

hardship.program: Credit card flexible payment options / hardship plan (shutdown-guidance page)
hardship.offers: Adjusted payment due date, hardship plan, financial guidance
hardship.how_to_ask: General assistance 1-888-438-9888
hardship.quote: Our customer support team is ready to work with you to find personalized solutions, whether that means adjusting your payment due date, setting up a hardship plan or offering financial guidance during this time.
